verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own positioning says you can share a booking link, connect your calendars, and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth. Supporting docs cover the pieces behind that: schedules that define when event types are bookable, an available-slots query, and calendar apps that check Outlook or Google for conflicts. Community users confirm they use it as a booking calendar (e.g. for recruiters) and prefer it to Calendly. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the public booking-page experience itself (the evidence is mostly API reference), and an unresolved hands-on report that availability seemed limited to 9am–5pm with no evening hours.
